title: THIS 4AM PRAYER WILL TERRORIZE THE KINGDOM OF DARKNESS THIS MORNING
text: It is 4 in the morning. The city is asleep. The streets are empty. The world has not yet decided what today will be. The sun has not given its permission for the day to begin. And in the kingdom of darkness, something has been noticed. A light, [music] small at first. A lamp being lit in a room where the enemy expected only sleep. A mouth opening in an hour when the enemy expected only silence. A spirit rising from rest and moving not toward the [music] day, but toward the throne room.
